Source: Dungeons and Dragon Ballz V.3, PDF page 137. Category: technique. Rank 1.

Rank 1 Ki technique
Ki Cost: 8
Prerequisites: none
Casting Time: 1 action
Range: 60 feet
Chargeable?: Yes
Duration: Instantaneous
Type: Beam
Fire a pure beam of energy with the full force of your
Ki. Make a Beam attack roll dealing a number of d6
equal to your wisdom modifier.
